diagnostics.message: Output iam_project_id is documented as depending on IAM bindings including the non-authoritative IAM members, but it has no dependency on resource.google_project_iam_member.additive. Its depends_on still references the removed resource google_project_iam_member.non_authoritative; it should instead depend on google_project_iam_member.additive so consumers of this output don't act before the additive (non-authoritative) IAM members are applied.
